question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.**
solution:
The correct answer is: poetry

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the definition of the given words.
 
 
• Poetry is a form of literature that uses aesthetic and often rhythmic qualities of language. (कविता)
 
• Music is the art of arranging sound to create some combination of form, harmony, melody, rhythm, or otherwise expressive content. (संगीत)
 
• Dance means to move the body and feet in rhythm to the music. (नृत्य)
 
• Pottery means the activity or skill of making clay objects by hand. (मिट्टी के बर्तनों)
 
 
 
• So, as per the definition of the given words, "poetry" should be used in the given sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is option 1.

Complete passage: *Our host started to read and the (1) chatter __stopped. There was a sweet __(2) silence __as each person read, not one that felt forced or imposed in any way. People did not seem to __(3) fidget __or cough, but perhaps that is just now I remember it now, I know I was increasingly self-conscious as the readings came closer to me and that when it was my turn I think I __(4) mumbled __through most of it, probably without making any sense of the **__(5) poetry__**.*
